renderings.technical:
### Changed

- Integrate the full M9 Frontend Redesign milestone into `main` and add the v1.9.0 release notes in `docs/releases/v1.9.0.md`. ([#244](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/244))

### Added

- Add inline `[n]` citation badges anchored in the sanitized Markdown assistant answer, with a hover/focus tooltip and unanchored citations kept in the sources list. ([#245](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/245))
- Add a primary action control in the ticket header driven by `SuggestedNextSteps`, now an `IReadOnlyList<SuggestedStep>` tagged with a `SuggestedActionKind`, with remaining steps in an overflow menu. ([#237](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/237))
- Add a keyboard-operable `CommandPalette` opened with `Ctrl/Cmd+K` on every page, offering navigation entries from `NavRegistry` and debounced, cancellable ticket search. ([#236](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/236))
- Apply ticket status changes optimistically on the board and detail view, rolling back on a rejected transition and showing a snackbar with the ProblemDetails `code`. ([#235](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/235))
- Replace `AssignTicketDialog.razor` and `ChangeStatusDialog.razor` with inline `MudMenu` popovers that change status and assignee without navigation or a modal. ([#234](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/234))
- Add inline citation badges with a hover and keyboard-focus tooltip to assistant chat answers, keeping a numbered sources list for unanchored citations. ([#233](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/233))
- Inject the active agent roster into the chat system prompt so the assistant uses only valid agent names when assigning tickets. ([#221](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/221))
- Enforce a `check_grounding` call via `tool_choice` in `AgentLoop` once after knowledge-base passages are retrieved, before the answer streams. ([#218](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/218))
- Introduce `Theme/DesignTokens.cs` as the single source for palette, spacing, radius, elevation and semantic chip colours, and change `KpiCard.Accent` to the `KpiAccent` tone enum. ([#213](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/213))

### Fixed

- Fix board card titles not clamping to two lines by wrapping the title in a `board-card__title-row` element. ([#240](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/240))
- Fix the assistant composer send button overflowing its panel by targeting the panel through `::deep .assistant-chat`. ([#239](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/239))
- Fix the `Category` header overlapping `Due` in the ticket queue by giving the column a fixed width and an uppercase label. ([#238](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/238))
- Add a chat system prompt policy that forbids claiming a change without a successful tool result and avoids needless re-confirmation of requested writes. ([#223](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/223))
- Render ticket summary timestamps in the `Anthropic:UserTimeZone` zone instead of UTC. ([#222](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/222))
- Report a failed `search_knowledge_base` call as an error result (`IsError: true`), distinct from the unavailable path. ([#220](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/220))
- Score grounding by semantic similarity with `SemanticGroundingEvaluator`, falling back to `LexicalGroundingEvaluator` when embeddings are unavailable or fail. ([#219](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/219))
